title.zh: Grayscale Launches In-Kind Investing Service Covering 10 Digital Assets, Includi
title.en: Grayscale Launches In-Kind Investing Service Covering 10 Digital Assets, Includi

current_state.zh: Grayscale introduced an in-kind investing service allowing eligible investors to exchange crypto directly for shares in 10 products covering BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, DOGE, and other digital assets.
current_state.en: Grayscale introduced an in-kind investing service allowing eligible investors to exchange crypto directly for shares in 10 products covering BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, DOGE, and other digital assets.
